title: FlashAttention v2/v3 stability heartbeat and regression profiling
creator: Miguel Alvarez
description: Introduce a lightweight heartbeat profiler and regression harness to continuously exercise FlashAttention v2 and v3 kernel paths across representative prefill and decode shapes. The goal is to detect subtle performance regressions (latency/throughput/jitter), memory-safety anomalies, and kernel-choice oscillation early, and provide automated graded fallback and traffic shaping to protect customer SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Heartbeat task runs on a subset of runtime fleet and produces daily artifacts (profiles + heatmaps) to ClickHouse/Telemetry. 2) Alerts trigger when 95th/99th token latency for v3 deviates >10% vs baseline or kernel oscillations exceed threshold. 3) Automated graded reroute policy (v3 -> v2 -> fallback-quant) can be enabled per-route. 4) Runbook documented and linked; one successful canary demonstrating reroute without customer impact.
progress_updates: 2025-02-16 - Spike completed: prototype heartbeat generator that emits 1.5k synthetic prefill+decode samples across 8 representative shape buckets (short/med/long + batch sizes). Miguel built proto harness and pushed initial data to local ClickHouse shard.
2025-02-20 - Telemetry schema v1 approved by Observability (tags: kernel.variant, kernel.layout, prefill_bucket, decode_batch, model.size). Added labels to runtime traces.

2025-02-24 - Perf experiment: v3 showed 7% median token slowdown on long-batch shapes vs baseline; 99th percentile increased by 18% on one node class. Started targeted profiling (nvprof + gdb sample) on failing nodes.

2025-02-27 - Root cause narrowed: v3 tiling heuristic selects microtile layout that increases workspace thrashing for mixed-precision quantized checkpoints. Reproducer created in qa/bench/microtile-repro. PR #3581 drafted to add a fallback chooser when workspace pressure metric > threshold.

2025-03-03 - Canary harness implemented: 1% traffic on dedicated canary pool now exercised with heartbeat and graded routing. Initial alert fired and reroute executed automatically (v3 -> v2) with no customer-visible error; follow-up analysis scheduled.
2025-03-04 - Documentation: runbook draft uploaded to Confluence; telemetry queries and dashboard templates added to docs.internal.redwood/flashattn-heartbeat-runbook.
decisions: Adopt a heartbeat-driven approach instead of periodic full synthetic bench runs to reduce cost and keep representative live shapes in the telemetry.
Implement graded reroute policy: soft-rate-limit -> route-to-v2 -> route-to-quant-fallback. This is reversible and controlled by per-route feature flags.
Do not ship a permanent v3 kernel blacklist; prefer dynamic workspace-pressure heuristics to preserve v3 benefits when safe.
Store detailed nvprof traces for top-10 anomalous nodes only to limit storage costs; sample others with lightweight timeline traces.
risks: False positives from heartbeat synthetic shapes that don't exactly match customer workloads could cause unnecessary reroutes.
Telemetry cardinality growth if prefill_bucket tagging is too fine-grained; need careful bucketing.
Automated reroute complexity could mask upstream regressions if the team relies too heavily on fallback without fixing root causes.
Memory: storing raw nvprof artifacts increases S3 costs; retention policy required.
reviewers_feedback: 2025-02-21 - Priya Rao (Observability): suggested coarser prefill_bucket mapping to avoid 10k+ label cardinality.
2025-02-25 - Jonah Lee (Serving): recommended adding workspace_pressure metric and exposing it as a kernel-selector signal before reroute.
2025-02-28 - Design Review (Anna B.): asked for clear user-facing messaging for any customer route that may be auto-rerouted; add opt-out for enterprise customers.
2025-03-02 - Security (Lena T.): approved telemetry plan after redaction of customer identifiers; requested KMS encryption for stored nvprof artifacts.
telemetry_queries: ClickHouse: SELECT toDate(timestamp) as day, kernel_variant, prefill_bucket, quantization, quantile(0.99)(token_latency_ms) FROM kernel_metrics WHERE day > today()-7 GROUP BY day, kernel_variant, prefill_bucket, quantization ORDER BY day
Prometheus Alert: (sum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (kernel_variant, prefill_bucket) / sum(rate(token_count[5m])) by (kernel_variant, prefill_bucket)) > (baseline * 1.10)
Trace filter: service=runtime AND tags.kernel.variant=v3 AND tags.prefill_bucket=long_batch AND error IS NULL ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 50
perf_results_summary: Initial heartbeat run (2025-02-24) across 8 buckets: v3 median token latency +7% on long-batch, v3 99th +18% on nodeclass-g12; v2 unchanged. Throughput impact observed only under >60% workspace_pressure. Reproducer suggests microtile layout change in v3 increases L2 thrashing on certain model widths. First mitigation (heuristic fallback when workspace_pressure>0.65) reduced 99th spike by ~12% in controlled canary.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Run heartbeat in shadow on 10% of canary pool for 2 weeks. Phase 2: Enable automated graded reroute for internal routes only, monitor for 72h. Phase 3: Open to all routes with enterprise opt-out and alerting thresholds. Phase 4: upstream fix in v3 tiler and gradual re-enable.
next_steps: Finalize PR #3581 with workspace_pressure metric and unit tests (owner: Sarah).
Add retention policy for nvprof artifacts (owner: Observability).
Implement enterprise opt-out flag and document customer communication template (owner: Product).
